request.project_task: Create an equipment checkout application for a media lab.
request.project_goal: Track who has borrowed each device.
request.project_description: Students request available equipment and staff record checkout and return.

functional_requirements.text: A student requests an available device.

atoms.text: A student requests an available device.

functional_requirements.text: A lab assistant records the checkout.

atoms.text: A lab assistant records the checkout.

functional_requirements.text: A lab assistant records the return and device condition.

atoms.text: A lab assistant records the return and device condition.

non_functional_requirements.text: Every checkout and return must be auditable.

actors.name: Student
actors.description: A student who requests available equipment.

actors.name: Lab Assistant
actors.description: Staff member who records checkouts and returns.

use_cases.name: Request Device
use_cases.goal: A student requests an available device.

steps.action: Student selects a device that is not available.

user_stories.benefit: I can borrow equipment for my project

system_stories.responsibility: System records the student's request for an available device.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Request Device
Goal: A student requests an available device.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Student needs a device.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: Student is authenticated.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Student selects an available device.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] Student submits the request.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] System records the request.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: Device not available
Source FRs: FR-001

use_cases.name: Record Checkout
use_cases.goal: A lab assistant records the checkout of a device.

steps.action: Lab assistant selects the device to check out.
Lab assistant attempts to check out a device that is not available.

user_stories.capability: record the checkout of a device
user_stories.benefit: I can track who has borrowed equipment

system_stories.responsibility: System records the checkout of a device by a student.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Record Checkout
Goal: A lab assistant records the checkout of a device.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: Student requests a device.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: Lab assistant is authenticated.
  - PRE-UC002-002: Device is available.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Lab assistant selects the device to check out.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] Lab assistant enters student information.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] Lab assistant confirms checkout.
  4. [STEP-UC002-004] System records the checkout.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-001: Device not available
Source FRs: FR-002

use_cases.name: Record Return
use_cases.goal: A lab assistant records the return and device condition.

success_postconditions.text: Return and device condition are recorded.

steps.action: Lab assistant selects the device being returned.
Lab assistant inspects the device and records its condition.
System records the return and device condition.
Lab assistant attempts to return a device that is not checked out.
steps.expected_result: System indicates device is not checked out.

user_stories.capability: record the return and device condition
user_stories.benefit: I can track equipment status and condition

system_stories.responsibility: System records the return of a device and its condition.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Record Return
Goal: A lab assistant records the return and device condition.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: Student returns a device.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: Lab assistant is authenticated.
  - PRE-UC003-002: Device is checked out.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Lab assistant selects the device being returned.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] Lab assistant inspects the device and records its condition.
  3. [STEP-UC003-003] Lab assistant confirms the return.
  4. [STEP-UC003-004] System records the return and device condition.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC003-EXC-001: Device not checked out
Source FRs: FR-003
